subject: Invoice & Billing Entity Change — Acme Analytics (post-acq)
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@acme-analytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: dana.price <dana.price@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Change of invoicing entity + outstanding invoices

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Quick note from Acme: we closed our acquisition by Summit Ventures this week and have consolidated entities. Effective 2026-03-01, our billing entity has changed to: 

  Acme Analytics Inc.
  600 Harbor Drive
  Suite 200
  San Francisco, CA 94107
  EIN: 94-1234567

We need Redwood to:
- Update future invoices and billing statements to the new legal name and address
- Reissue invoice #RWD-2026-302 (due 2026-03-10) to Acme Analytics Inc. (current invoice was issued to Acme Labs LLC)
- Confirm how VAT / sales tax handling will change (if any) and whether we need a new tax form on file
- Provide instructions for payment remittance going forward (bank details or payable address)

I attached a cover letter from our legal team with the merger notice. Please let me know what docs you need (W-9, signed amendment, PO update). We’re trying to centralize AP and keep our vendor master tidy.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP Finance, Acme Analytics
Attachment: Acme_Merger_Cover_Letter.pdf (PDF, 214KB)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jordan.meyers <jordan.meyers@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of invoicing entity + outstanding invoices

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and congrats on closing. I’ve looped in Marcus (billing) and Monica (payments) so we can take the required steps. A couple quick items from our side: 

- We can reissue RWD-2026-302 as requested; please confirm the exact legal name line and billing address (you listed above — that works but we’ll need the W-9 or equivalent tax form on file).
- For US customers we rely on the W-9 and a signed billing amendment for entity/name changes. We also need someone in AP to confirm whether they consider this a vendor rename only or a new vendor record (the latter can affect open credits and payment remittance).
- Sales tax / VAT: because this is a US-headquartered entity, our billing tax behaviour stays the same; if you have EU VAT registrations tied to the entity, send us the VAT ID and we’ll note it on the account.

Marcus/Monica — can you advise on the workflow and estimated turnaround (reissue + updated billing profile)? Also flag any outstanding credits tied to the previous entity.

Next steps: Jordan, if you can send the W-9 and the signed amendment (DocuSign link is fine) we’ll prioritize this and push reissued invoice and a remittance memo.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, jordan.meyers <jordan.meyers@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of invoicing entity + outstanding invoices

Morning all — from Billing team:

- We can reissue invoice RWD-2026-302 to Acme Analytics Inc. and mark the original as replaced (audit trail preserved). ETA: 2 business days after we receive signed amendment + tax form.
- Outstanding balance on the account (pre-change) is $18,720.00 (invoice breakdown attached). If Acme treats this as a new vendor, there will be one-time vendor-master update tasks in our ERP and AP will need to route the payment to the new remit details once confirmed.
- For remittance: we require written confirmation of bank details or an AP payable address; we do not accept emailed bank change requests without double-confirmation (internal security control). A DocuSign amendment that includes the new remit address is preferable.

Attachment: billing_summary_RWD-ACME-MAR2026.xlsx (stub)

I’ll open the vendor-update ticket (VIN-8493) and assign to finance ops. Monica, please watch for the DocuSign and confirm the W-9 is US-CITIZEN/TIN valid.

Thanks,
Marcus
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@acme-analytics.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: dana.price <dana.price@acme-analytics.com>, emily.tran <e.tran@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of invoicing entity + outstanding invoices

Thanks, Laura and team — attaching signed W-9 and the executed billing amendment. We’ve also uploaded the DocuSign for the amendment (link below).

- Attachment: Acme_W9_signed.pdf (PDF, 98KB)
- Attachment: signed-ammendment-acme.pdf (PDF, 46KB)
- DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/abcd1234

Note on remittance: AP will keep the same bank account for now; they only changed the legal name and address. If you need additional proof of the bank account, let me know and I’ll arrange a bank letter.

Also: please confirm whether the previously issued credit memo CM-2026-017 will carry over to the updated entity record or if you prefer we reapply it to the reissued invoice.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Jordan
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: jordan.meyers <jordan.meyers@acme-analytics.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of invoicing entity + outstanding invoices

Jordan — all set from payments side. Summary of actions taken: 

1) Vendor record updated to Acme Analytics Inc. (Vendor ID: V-12288).
2) Reissued invoice: RWD-2026-302-R (original RWD-2026-302 replaced). New invoice PDF sent to emily.tran@acme-analytics.com and to the Redwood billing inbox (copy attached).
3) Credit memo CM-2026-017: we re-applied the credit to the reissued invoice per your request. Remaining outstanding balance is $9,120.00 after applying the credit and a partial payment we received on 2026-03-05.
4) Billing address and tax info updated on the account; W-9 filed. No EU VAT changes detected.
5) Payment instructions: please continue ACH to Redwood Payments LLC — account details on the invoice (we will not change bank details without additional bank-letter verification).

Attachments: RWD-2026-302-R.pdf (Invoice PDF, 32KB)

If you need the vendor legal name reflected differently on your internal POs for seamless AP matching, tell us the exact PO prefix and we’ll add it to the vendor notes. Otherwise, consider this complete and we’ll watch for payment.

Best,
Monica Patel
Payments Manager
Redwood Inference
